sources.entry: Markout - Native Markdown editor with live preview, offline KaTeX math, Mermaid diagrams, and HTML/PDF export.

summary.one_liner: Markout is a native macOS Markdown editor (SwiftUI, TextKit, WKWebView) with live preview, fully offline math, diagram rendering, and HTML/PDF export.
summary.what_it_does: Markout is a Markdown editor for macOS 14 or later, built with SwiftUI, TextKit, and WKWebView, and described as a successor to the unmaintained MacDown. It provides a split editor with a live preview that renders after a 150 ms debounce, with Markdown syntax highlighting and switchable editor and preview themes. The preview supports GitHub-Flavored Markdown via cmark-gfm, highlight.js code highlighting, KaTeX math, and Mermaid diagrams, with all engines vendored so rendering works offline. Documents can be exported as standalone HTML with inlined CSS or as PDF, and the app also offers a table of contents, YAML front matter parsing, find and replace, image paste, and a formatting toolbar. Windows open as native tabs, with a welcome window listing recent documents and a markout command for opening files from the terminal.
use_cases: write and preview Markdown documents on a Mac
edit Markdown with live rendered math formulas
draw Mermaid diagrams inside Markdown notes
export Markdown to standalone HTML or PDF
offline Markdown editing without a hosted service
open Markdown files from the terminal on macOS
notable: Everything renders offline; syntax, math, and diagram engines are vendored rather than loaded from a CDN
Native window tabs and a welcome window with a recent-documents list
Editor-to-preview scroll sync and switchable preview themes with custom CSS support
Available as a Homebrew cask and a .dmg download, with a markout CLI to open files
Formatting toolbar and Format menu with undoable actions
caveats: Requires macOS 14 or later; Apple Silicon recommended
The app is ad-hoc signed but not notarized, so Gatekeeper warns on first launch and may need the quarantine flag cleared
Building from source requires Xcode and XcodeGen
